The '''Corellian Communications Center''' was located in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] set up a headquarters there.
